versions.content: If  UdpNmPnEraCalcEnabled is TRUE  a NM-PDU is received  PNs are requested within this message (bits are set to 1)  and the requested PNs are set to 1 within the [configured PN filter mask] then UdpNm shall store the request information (value 1) for these PNs

{DRAFT} If  UdpNmPnEraCalcEnabled is TRUE  a NM-PDU is received  PNSR bit is 0  PNs are requested within this message (bits are set to 1)  and the requested PNs are set to 1 within the [configured PN filter mask] then UdpNm shall store the request information (value 1) for these PNs
